description:
Advances: specled.api_boundary

Review-bar-override: four pure refactors on the hot path of a release branch — deferred as a batch for the same reason the review dropped a sibling readability finding.

From the critical review of specled_-n5q. All four are Low, all four are consensus findings (idioms + simplicity), and none change behavior. Batched because they touch the same two modules and are best done in one pass with the suite as the check.

1. F10 — hash decoding implemented twice across a module boundary. ApiBoundary.entry_hash/1 is a character-for-character copy of the decode inside HashStore.fetch/3. Introduced by this branch: splitting out fetch_entry/3 was right, but the decode was copied rather than moved. Fix: one public HashStore.entry_hash/1, compose fetch/3 from it, delete the private copy. HashStore owns the on-disk format; ApiBoundary should not know a hash is hex. (Note: the branch DID add an is_binary guard to the ApiBoundary copy, so the two are no longer identical — reconcile when merging them.)

2. F9 — Orchestrator.api_boundary_hashes/2 hand-rolls the dedupe that dedupe_by_mfa/2 already does. Both reviewers produced the same behavior-preserving sketch: widen the callback to return the entry, route through the existing helper, delete the "parity by construction" comment. ~10 fewer lines.

3. F13 — Map.get(f, "code") or Map.get(f, :code) written four times: has_drift?, has_dangling?, has_divergence?, plus an inline copy in drift_dangling_pairs/1. Fix: finding_code/1 + has_code?/2 + module attributes for the three codes; drive drift_dangling_pairs/1 from the same attribute and rename it for what it now does (it covers divergence too).

4. F11 — comment blocks restating ADRs committed in the same branch. The assume-beam refutation lives in five places; this ticket own history records two restatements that had already gone false and needed a remediation commit. Trim the refuted-alternative paragraph in comparable?/2 and the 381-binding incident history in collect_bindings/2 to one-line ADR pointers. Keep the 4-tuple vs 5-tuple envelope paragraph — that one earns its place.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.api_boundary, specled.binding, specled.branch_guard

(CORRECTED by orchestrator — the ticket carried only specled.api_boundary. The four items span
three modules owned by three subjects:
  F10 decode dedup       -> hash_store.ex:150-163 + api_boundary.ex:191-201 -> binding + api_boundary
  F9  api_boundary_hashes/2 -> orchestrator.ex:966-1006                      -> branch_guard
  F13 code-check helpers -> orchestrator.ex:396-414, 686-708                 -> branch_guard
  F11 comment trims      -> api_boundary.ex:164-184 + orchestrator.ex:478-490 -> api_boundary + branch_guard)

DECISION-CLASS: NO. Code only. Merge without hold. Four behavior-preserving refactors, no new
requirement, no ADR, no stub flip, no baseline movement. Spec-file touches are
surface-ownership bookkeeping only.

RUNS FIRST IN ITS LINEAGE. specled_-vzd.2 and specled_-vzd.6 are wired to depend on this ticket.
Note the deliberate priority inversion: this is P4 and vzd.2 is P3, but the dependency runs this
way because vzd.4 F13's rename of drift_dangling_pairs/1 would otherwise land on a function
vzd.2 just reshaped.

CORRECTION TO A COMMON ASSUMPTION: making HashStore.entry_hash/1 public does NOT move an
api_boundary hash. .spec/realization_hashes.json has exactly ONE tier (api_boundary, 173
entries, no implementation section). No SpecLedEx.Realization.* module is bound bare, so no
head-union hash recomputes when HashStore gains an export; HashStore's bound MFAs are only
read/2, write/2, merge/2, whose heads are untouched. Hashing is also line-shift stable, so
inserting a function above write/2 does not move it either.

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex
- lib/specled_ex/realization/hash_store.ex
- lib/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator.ex
- .spec/specs/api_boundary.spec.md
- .spec/specs/binding.spec.md
- .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md
- test/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/realization/hash_store_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs
- .spec/realization_hashes.json — ESCAPE HATCH ONLY. It should NOT need to change; a diff here
  means something behavioral leaked in. Stop and re-read your diff.
NO ADR. Do not touch .spec/decisions/.

Out of Scope (files):
- the other nine lib/specled_ex/realization/*.ex
- docs/**
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex

Out of Scope (intent):
- ZERO behavior change. If any test changes its expected values, STOP — the refactor is wrong.
- F10: reconcile the is_binary guard the release branch added to the ApiBoundary copy
  (api_boundary.ex:191) with HashStore.fetch/3's unguarded decode (hash_store.ex:154-158). The
  merged public entry_hash/1 keeps the guarded nil-returning behavior AND the malformed-entry
  rationale at api_boundary.ex:198-201 (4 lines, load-bearing — MOVE it, do not delete it).
- F13: do not add a fourth code and do not change any code string. Deduplicate the four
  Map.get(f, "code") || Map.get(f, :code) sites only.
- F11: KEEP the 4-tuple/5-tuple envelope paragraph (api_boundary.ex:164-167) — it earns its
  place. Trim only :168-184 (the assume-beam refutation) and orchestrator.ex:484-490 (the
  381-binding incident history) to one-line specled.decision.* pointers.
- Do NOT "while I'm here" fix orchestrator.ex:809-822's bare "See atlas-vmi." pointer. Out of
  scope, and it names a non-ADR.

Verification:
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix test                                    # FULL suite — this is a behavior-preservation
                                              # claim, so the scope is deliberately wide
  mix format --check-formatted
  mix deps.unlock --check-unused
  make xref
  git diff --stat .spec/realization_hashes.json   # MUST be empty
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
No stub flips. No new requirements.

Expected diff: 6-9 files, ~140 changed lines, NET -40 (F9 alone ~-10; F11 ~-25).
